description_i18n.zh-TW: 雪季寒流過境的福壽山農場：茶園與果園步道積雪、遠望合歡群峰雪稜；雪季窗內地面有雪、氣溫≤1°C、能見度≥3km 時成立。
description_i18n.en: Fushoushan Farm after a cold snap in snow season: snow on the tea terraces and orchard paths, the Hehuan ridgeline white in the distance - qualifies inside the snow-season window with ground snow, temp <= 1 C, visibility >= 3 km.
description_i18n.ja: 雪季の寒波通過後の福寿山農場：茶園と果樹園の歩道の積雪、遠くの合歓稜線の雪 — 雪季窓内で地面に雪、気温 ≤1°C、視程 ≥3 km のとき成立。

observation_relations.uncertainty_note: Subject-specific angles/distance not re-verified in CL-DATA-74 (same viewpoint geometry as the sibling subject).

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 地面有雪（派生三級 snow_cover_state：snowing/snow_covered/none；僅 none 否決）。票面語義「snowfall>0 或 snow_depth>0」由派生層摺疊為單一狀態——OR，不是 AND；降雪中地面未積也成立。兩個雪欄位皆缺 → 誠實 not_evaluatable（fail-closed）。
rationale_i18n.en: Ground snow (derived three-level snow_cover_state: snowing/snow_covered/none; only 'none' vetoes). The ticket OR semantics (snowfall > 0 OR snow_depth > 0) collapses into this single state - an OR, not an AND; falling snow with a bare ground still qualifies. Both snow fields missing -> honestly not_evaluatable (fail-closed).
rationale_i18n.ja: 地面の雪（派生3段階 snow_cover_state：snowing/snow_covered/none；none のみ否決）。OR 意味論は派生層で単一状態に畳む—ANDではなくOR。降雪中で積雪なしでも成立。両雪欄欠損は誠実に not_evaluatable（fail-closed）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 氣溫 ≤1°C：雪面不融化——氣溫高於 1°C 時積雪迅速消融、雪面濕暗反光失格；1°C 給融雪反光的邊際餘量。provisional。
rationale_i18n.en: Air temp <= 1 C: the snowpack stays frozen - above 1 C lying snow melts fast and a wet, dark surface loses the snow look; 1 C keeps a marginal band for refreezing-melt surfaces. Provisional.
rationale_i18n.ja: 気温 ≤1°C：雪面が融けない — 1°C超では積雪が急速に融け湿った暗い面になり雪景色が失格。1°Cは再凍結・融解の境界の余裕。暫定値。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 能見度 ≥3 km：雪中可拍的界線——暴雪/白牆（ホワイトアウト）否決，飄雪本身不否決（雪中拍攝反而是氛圍加分；jp-047 樹氷語義同源）。
rationale_i18n.en: Visibility >= 3 km: the shootable-in-snow line - blizzard/whiteout vetoes, falling snow itself does not (shooting in falling snow is atmosphere-positive; same semantics as the jp-047 snow-monster gate).
rationale_i18n.ja: 視程 ≥3 km：雪中撮影可の境界 — 吹雪・ホワイトアウトは否決、降雪自体は否決しない（雪中撮影はむしろ雰囲気加点。jp-047 樹氷と同語義）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 季節窗判定（window_open/window_closed，例年窗 12-01~02-28 讀自 seasonal-calendar.json，實況優先，兩者皆缺時誠實 not_evaluatable）：雪季窗是本題材的硬性約束（CL-DATA-74 owner 核可資料包）。
rationale_i18n.en: Seasonal-window verdict (window_open/window_closed; typical window 12-01~02-28 from seasonal-calendar.json, observed takes precedence, neither present = honestly not_evaluatable): the season window is this subject's hard constraint (CL-DATA-74 owner-approved data pack).
rationale_i18n.ja: 季節窓判定（window_open/window_closed。例年窓 12-01~02-28 は seasonal-calendar.json から、実況優先、両方なければ誠実に not_evaluatable）：季節窓は本題材のハード制約（CL-DATA-74 オーナー承認データパック）。
